phonation_path.feature_type: Acoustic vocal phonation (pitch, voicing, jitter, shimmer, HNR, F0 mean) + validity mask
phonation_path.normalization: NaN to 0.0 + concatenated binary validity mask

projection_architecture.semantic_head: Linear(1024, 256) -> BatchNorm1d -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.15) -> Linear(256, 128) -> L2_norm
projection_architecture.phonation_head: Linear(12, 64) -> BatchNorm1d -> ReLU -> Dropout(0.10) -> Linear(64, 32) -> L2_norm
